body:
Somewhere in Newcastle right now, a business is paying more rent than the company next door. Same building. Same floor size. But the neighbour got three months rent-free, a contribution towards their fit-out, and a reduced make-good at the end of the term.

The first business got none of it. Not because they were unlucky — because no one on their side of the table told them it was possible.

If you're searching for a Newcastle leasing agent to help you find or renew an office, it's worth knowing there are two very different roles at that table — and only one of them is on your side.

## Tenant rep vs leasing agent: what's the difference?

A leasing agent is paid by the landlord to lease their space. A tenant representative — a "tenant rep" — is a licensed commercial property advisor who works only for the tenant. Same industry, opposite sides of the table.

A tenant rep finds your space, runs the numbers, negotiates the lease and chases every incentive on your behalf. The leasing agent across the table is doing the same thing — for the landlord. For most business owners in Newcastle, that's the difference between negotiating alone and having an expert in your corner.

## Why the leasing agent isn't working for you

It's not a scandal. It's just how the table is set. The agent is paid by the landlord, answers to the landlord, and is there to get the best result for the landlord. The problem is that most tenants sit down assuming someone's in their corner. No one is.

And here's the catch. You'll sign a commercial lease maybe once every five or ten years. The agent across from you does deals every week. That experience gap costs real money — money you never see leave, because it was never yours to begin with. The rent-free period you could have had. The incentive that was on the table. The clause that quietly favours the landlord for the next seven years.

There's also the stock you never see. In Newcastle, more than half of commercial property is leased before it's ever advertised. Without the right relationships, you're only ever looking at what's left.

## The pie no one warns you about

Think of your move or fit-out as a pie with a fixed size. From day one, agents, contractors and suppliers all want a slice. The greedy ones take more than their share early, and you don't notice until the budget's gone and the quality drops at the back end. By then it's too late.

A good tenant rep gets in before the pie starts shrinking — and keeps it whole.

We built Your Office Space to sit on your side of that table. But we wanted to go further than "trust us." Every advisor says that.

So here's ours: we only invoice our fee once we've secured you at least three times that fee in measurable value — rent-free periods, fit-out contributions, make-good reductions, reduced rent across your term and negotiated incentives, combined. If we don't get you there, you don't pay it.

It flips the relationship. We don't get paid for showing up. We get paid for putting money back in your pocket — a lot more than we cost.

## Why we can back it

One reason: we know this market. A decade in commercial property across Newcastle and the Hunter. Relationships with the agents who move the off-market stock. When you know where the value is and how to negotiate for it, a guarantee like this isn't a gamble — it's confidence.

You're good at running your business. Commercial property is our job, not yours. Let us take the whole thing off your plate and only pay us once we've proven it three times over.

## Frequently asked questions

**What does a tenant representative do in Newcastle?**

A tenant rep represents businesses — not landlords — through the entire leasing journey: finding the right space, analysing the market, negotiating rent and incentives, reviewing the lease alongside your solicitor, and managing the move. You get one advocate from the first conversation to the final handover.

**Do I need a tenant rep or a Newcastle leasing agent?**

If you own a property and want to lease it out, you use a leasing agent. If you're a business looking to lease, renew or relocate, a tenant rep works for you — while the leasing agent across the table works for the landlord.

**How much does tenant representation cost in Newcastle?**

At Your Office Space, our professional fee is only payable once we've secured you at least three times that fee in measurable value. If we don't, you don't pay. We confirm the exact fee in a tailored proposal after understanding your needs.

**Is more than half the commercial market really off-market?**

In Newcastle, over 50% of commercial property is transacted before it's advertised. Access to that stock comes through local agent relationships — which is what a well-connected tenant rep brings to the table.

**What areas do you cover?**

Newcastle CBD, Honeysuckle, Broadmeadow, Charlestown, Maitland, Lake Macquarie and across the Hunter Region.
